title: Cognito Authentication With React: A Small, Verifiable Setup

cover.alt: Transparent architectural authentication gateway with account tiles and three distinct token paths

figures.title: Account state changes before tokens are useful
figures.summary: The article separates registration, confirmation, sign-in and refresh.

items.label: Sign up
items.detail: Create the account in an unconfirmed state.

items.label: Sign in
items.detail: Authenticate and receive the configured token set.

items.label: Refresh
items.detail: Obtain new session tokens while refresh conditions remain valid.

figures.caption: The account lifecycle explained in the article; token presence alone does not authorize a backend request.

figures.title: Check the boundaries before adding more UI
figures.summary: Configuration and session behavior need independent checks.

items.label: Public client
items.detail: Do not put a client secret in browser code.

items.label: Pool configuration
items.detail: Match the app client and regional user-pool identifiers.

items.label: Known test user
items.detail: Verify a small sign-in path before expanding registration.

items.label: Session state
items.detail: Handle signed-out and expired-session states deliberately.

items.label: Backend verification
items.detail: Validate tokens and their expiry before trusting API requests.

figures.caption: Checks described in the setup and security sections; decoding a JWT is inspection, not signature verification.
